siteSettings.title: English Adventures: Although, Despite, In Spite Of

lesson.title: Although/Though/Even Though vs. Despite/In Spite Of

modules.name: Learn
modules.title: Contrast Marker Lessons
modules.instructions: Master although, even though, despite, and in spite of to show contrasting ideas. Understand the key distinction: although/even though take subject + verb, while despite/in spite of take nouns or gerunds.

modules.name: Write
modules.title: Writing Practice
modules.instructions: Write sentences using although/even though (with complete clauses) and despite/in spite of (with noun phrases or gerunds) to express contrast. Apply proper punctuation and word order.

modules.name: Play
modules.title: Contrast Games
modules.instructions: Play games to practice distinguishing between although/even though and despite/in spite of. Recognize grammatical structures and choose the correct contrast marker.

modules.name: Apply
modules.title: Contrast Challenge
modules.instructions: Apply contrast structures correctly in complex sentences and master the grammar rules. Spell contrast-related terminology precisely.
